note: What this project considers unpublishable. Read by quality/checks/prepublication.py. Path prefixes and exemptions live here because a prefix is not sensitive; the names inside those paths are, and those are supplied at runtime from outside the repository.
citation_exempt_note: CHANGELOG.md records what shipped in each version, including entries written before this policy existed. Rewriting released changelog text is a rewrite of history rather than an edit, so it is exempted and the policy applies to everything written from here on.
